subject: VAT reclassification + retro credit request — Emerald Systems invoice May 2026
messages:
From: Liam O'Sullivan <liam@emeraldsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@emeraldsys.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Billing inquiry — VAT treatment and credit request for May invoice

Hi Jonas,

We've reviewed invoice #RWD-202605-EM (attached) and noticed VAT was applied at 0% while our records indicate Emerald Systems should have been charged with German VAT at 19% for May usage. This results in a material reclassification on our side and tax exposure for our auditors.

Can Redwood: 1) reclassify the VAT on that invoice, 2) issue a retroactive credit for the difference (or a corrected invoice), and 3) provide a formal credit note we can attach to our ledger?

I've attached the invoice and our VAT registration certificate for reference. Our accounting team needs the credit note and updated invoice by July 3 to close the month.

Attachments: emerald_invoice_may2026.pdf (application/pdf), eu_vat_certificate_emr.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Liam O'Sullivan
Head of Finance Operations — Emerald Systems
liam@emeraldsys.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Sullivan <liam@emeraldsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing inquiry — VAT treatment and credit request for May invoice

Liam — thanks for the heads up and for the docs. I'm looping in Laura from Finance and Priyom from Billing so we can triage and confirm next steps.

Quick summary of what we'll do:
- Finance to validate the VAT registration (Laura)
- If reclassification is required, Billing to issue a corrected invoice + credit note and confirm tax treatment (Priyom)
- We'll provide a credit note and a reissued invoice PDF for your records and send a confirmation email to close the loop.

Can you confirm whether Emerald would like the credit applied as a single retro credit on next month's statement or issued as a refund? Also confirm the entity legal name for the credit note (as it should appear).

I'll follow up by end of day with an ETA.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Office: +1-415-555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Sullivan <liam@emeraldsys.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing inquiry — VAT treatment and credit request for May invoice

Hi Liam,

Thanks — I pulled the invoice and Emerald's VAT cert. Two quick notes:
1) The invoice was processed under our EU marketplace flow which defaulted to 0% VAT because the system did not pick up the supplied VAT ID against our validation checks.
2) If Emerald's VAT ID is valid (the cert you sent looks fine), we can reissue the invoice showing 19% VAT and a corresponding credit note for the net-to-gross delta.

Action plan and timeline:
- Today: Finance will validate the VAT ID against the EU VIES system and produce a draft credit note.
- Mon 29 Jun: Billing will reissue corrected invoice + credit note; we'll include a breakdown spreadsheet.
- Tue 30 Jun: I'll attach the signed credit note and final invoice and confirm the credit note number you should reference.

For the refund vs. statement credit question — Emerald's preference will determine the payment flow. If you want a refund, please confirm bank details; otherwise we can apply the credit to July's statement.

I've attached the Redwood credit note template we'll use.

Attachments: redwood_credit_note_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@emeraldsys.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Sullivan <liam@emeraldsys.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing inquiry — VAT treatment and credit request for May invoice

Laura / Jonas — thanks for the quick turnaround and plan. Emerald confirms:
- Please reissue the corrected invoice and produce a separate credit note (we prefer a formal credit note rather than an unapplied statement credit).
- Legal name for the credit note: Emerald Systems GmbH
- We will take the credit as an offset (no cash refund) and will attach the credit note to our May close.

Request: please include the credit note number and the original invoice reference on the credit note, and send us a PDF we can file. Once we have the PDFs we will confirm internally and close this on our side.

Thanks again — much appreciated.

Best,
Sofia Marin
Accounting Manager — Emerald Systems
sofia.marin@emeraldsys.com
